categories.main_business_segments: Transcene Co., Ltd operates primarily in resource recycling and environmental protection industries, focusing on recycling waste materials from semiconductor and solar industries into valuable products. Its main business segments include recycled product sales such as spherical silica powder, silicon pellets, crystalline ceramic powder, and biodegradable plastic decomposers, as well as providing circular economy technical consulting services. The company also engages in waste treatment and recycling services, including chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) sludge processing and semiconductor packaging waste recycling.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary recycling and processing technologies, including pyro-metallurgical and wet chemical methods to extract and refine silicon and silica materials from industrial waste. Key production methods include decarbonization and degluing processes for waste packaging materials to produce spherical silica powder, drying and roasting CMP sludge to produce crystalline ceramic powder, and pelletizing silicon sludge for steelmaking applications. It also develops biodegradable plastic decomposers and integrates advanced powder processing techniques such as particle size control, surface property optimization, and flowability enhancement to meet customer specifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include semiconductor manufacturers, semiconductor packaging companies, steel mills, construction material producers, and plastic product manufacturers. The company serves industries such as semiconductor IC packaging, solar wafer production, steelmaking, plastics, coatings, and building materials. Major clients include leading Taiwanese semiconductor packaging firms and steel manufacturers, with products used as fillers, additives, and raw materials in various industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with manufacturing facilities located in Tainan (Liuying) and Taichung (Central Taiwan Science Park). It serves domestic markets extensively and is actively expanding into international markets including Europe, the United States, China, South Korea, and Norway. Export sales account for a smaller portion of revenue but are targeted for growth, especially for industrial-grade spherical silica and recycled materials.
categories.supply_chain_position: Transcene operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It collects and processes industrial waste materials (upstream waste producers) into recycled raw materials and products, which are then supplied to downstream manufacturers such as semiconductor packaging firms, steel mills, and construction material producers. The company also provides technical consulting services to support circular economy practices within the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in recycling technologies and product quality enhancement, focusing on developing high-purity spherical silica powders, advanced crystalline ceramic powders, and biodegradable plastic decomposers. It collaborates with major domestic semiconductor and green energy firms for joint development projects and invests in equipment upgrades and process optimization to improve product performance and reduce carbon footprint. Future R&D includes expanding solar panel waste recycling technologies and overseas technology transfer to replicate successful models internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of recycled materials such as spherical silica powder, silicon pellets, and crystalline ceramic powder, as well as fees from waste treatment and recycling services. The company also earns income from technical consulting services related to circular economy solutions and may engage in licensing or technology transfer agreements. Contractual agreements with major clients for waste processing and product supply form a significant portion of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with established suppliers of high-grade spherical silica powders and recycled materials, including Japanese, American, Korean, and Chinese manufacturers. Its competitive advantages lie in proprietary recycling technologies, strong relationships with semiconductor packaging firms, and certifications such as environmental labels and green building material certifications. Transcene holds a leading market share in Taiwan's waste treatment and recycled material supply for semiconductor packaging and CMP sludge processing, with over 80% market share in packaging waste treatment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$200 million, representing a 60% increase from the previous year. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss of about NT$79 million due to extended product certification periods and increased depreciation from new plant investments. The company has shown steady growth in revenue driven by expanded production capacity and new product lines, with ongoing investments in R&D and facility expansion to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Transcene emphasizes its unique ability to convert semiconductor and solar industry waste into high-quality recycled materials with low carbon footprints, supporting customers' sustainability goals. Its products offer superior performance characteristics such as enhanced mechanical strength, thermal conductivity, and environmental compliance, differentiating them from virgin materials. The company’s closed-loop recycling approach and proprietary technologies enable clients to reduce Scope 3 carbon emissions and achieve circular economy objectives, creating significant environmental and economic value.
